## Load packages and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
library(tmap)

gii <- read_csv(here("data", "HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv"),
                locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")) %>%
  clean_names()

```
## Load world boundaries

```{r}
world <- st_read(here("data", "World_Countries_(Generalized).geojson")) %>%
  clean_names()
```

## Calculate diff in GII (2019 - 2010)

```{r}
gii_clean <- gii %>%
  dplyr::select(iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010)
```

## Convert ISO2 codes to ISO3

```{r}
world_iso3 <- world %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(iso, origin = "iso2c", destination = "iso3c"))
```

## Join GII to world boundaries

```{r}
world_gii <- world_iso3 %>%
  left_join(gii_clean, by = "iso3")
```

## Check & preview
```{r}
world_gii %>%
  filter(is.na(gii_diff)) %>%
  pull(country)

qtm(world_gii, fill = "gii_diff")
```
